arguments:
{"script":"set -euo pipefail
ws="temp_var_workspace"
mkdir -p "$ws"
# permissions and ownership snapshot (recursive)
find /var -printf "%M %u:%g %p\n" > "$ws/var_access_snapshot.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
# full recursive listing with attributes
find /var -exec stat -c "%F %A %h %U %G %s %y %n" {} \; > "$ws/var_listing.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
# keep only regular files from the listing
grep -E '^regular file ' "$ws/var_listing.txt" > "$ws/var_files_only.txt" || true
# record line count
wc -l < "$ws/var_files_only.txt" > "$ws/var_files_intermediate_count.txt"
# verify the count file is readable
if [ -r "$ws/var_files_intermediate_count.txt" ]; then echo "count_file_readable=1" >> "$ws/var_files_intermediate_count.txt"; else echo "count_file_readable=0" >&2; exit 1; fi
# consolidate files
{
  echo "--- var_files_only.txt ---"
  cat "$ws/var_files_only.txt"
  echo "--- var_files_intermediate_count.txt ---"
  cat "$ws/var_files_intermediate_count.txt"
  echo "--- var_access_snapshot.txt ---"
  cat "$ws/var_access_snapshot.txt"
} > "$ws/var_count_metadata.txt"
# confirm consistency
count=$(awk 'NR==1{print $1}' "$ws/var_files_intermediate_count.txt")
lines=$(wc -l < "$ws/var_files_only.txt")
if [ "$count" -eq "$lines" ]; then echo "CONSISTENT: $count"; else echo "INCONSISTENT: count_file=$count lines=$lines" >&2; exit 2; fi
# final output: print the total number only
echo "$count"
"}
